description: This file defines a SwiftUI wrapper ('ScreenWebView') for embedding a WKWebView, along with a coordinator class ('ScreenWebViewCoordinator') that manages WebView lifecycle, delegates, and message handling. It also contains delegate classes for navigation and script message handling, specifically designed for handling deep links and canvas UI actions within an iOS application.

classes.name: ScreenWebViewCoordinator
classes.description: Acts as the delegate and coordinator for the WKWebView, managing its lifecycle, navigation, and message handling.

classes.name: ScreenNavigationDelegate
classes.description: Handles WKWebView navigation policies, intercepting custom URI schemes like 'openclaw://'.

classes.name: CanvasA2UIActionMessageHandler
classes.description: Handles script messages from web content related to UI actions, passing them to the controller after validation.

methods.name: makeContainerView
methods.description: Creates and configures the container UIView and WKWebView, setting up layout constraints.

methods.name: updateController
methods.description: Updates the controller reference and reattaches/detaches WebView as needed.

methods.name: teardown
methods.description: Cleans up references and delegates, removing handlers and nullifying the WebView.

methods.name: makeWebView
methods.description: Factory method to instantiate and configure WKWebView with specific settings.

methods.name: installA2UIHandlers
methods.description: Registers script message handlers for UI actions.

methods.name: webView(decidePolicyFor:decisionHandler:)
methods.description: Decides whether to allow navigation or intercept deep links with custom scheme.

methods.name: webView(didFinish:)
methods.description: Handles successful page load, updating status.

methods.name: userContentController(_:didReceive:)
methods.description: Processes messages from the web content related to UI actions.
